title: Positional Encoding: How Transformers Learn Where Tokens Sit
summary: From sinusoids to RoPE to NoPE — how transformers know where each token sits. Building Absolute PE, Sinusoidal, Learned, Relative PE, ALiBi, RoPE, p-RoPE, and NoPE from scratch in PyTorch. Six explicit position schemes plus the no-PE hybrid that ships in SmolLM3 and Gemma 4.
author: David Hoang

title: Attention Variants: From Self-Attention to GQA, MLA, SWA, and Beyond
summary: Building every major attention mechanism from scratch in PyTorch — GQA, MLA, SWA, NSA, Gated Attention, and Hybrid Attention. Six efficiency variants that solve the bottlenecks of standard attention: KV cache memory, quadratic cost, and training instability at scale.
author: David Hoang

title: Self-Attention and Multi-Head Attention
summary: The single equation that changed NLP shipped in 2017 inside Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani et al.). By the end of this post you will have built, from scratch in PyTorch, working implementations of Self-Attention, Multi-Head Attention, Causal Self-Attention, and Cross-Attention — the four building blocks that power every transformer.
author: David Hoang
